status: Scoped queued-signing review, consent, phishing veto and parser checkpoint passed. Cross-protocol backend ownership, WalletConnect and final release gates remain open.
sourceEquivalence: All src, tests, package.json and yarn.lock bytes at checkpointTree equal tested sourceCommit. Only the browser harness differs from that application commit. Speculative header CSS e4f2f867 was reverted at482217ab after raw-pixel verification disproved the reported disappearance.
changes: Remove automatic mobile signing; review the currently displayed Substrate, EVM or Solana request before explicit approval. Consent, raw expansion and request ownership reset on replacement; duplicate and late UI actions cannot approve another displayed request.

Show browser-normalized full origin with registrable-domain emphasis, same-origin HTTPS favicon with globe fallback, exact account/address copy, network identity, honest fee kind and full raw data. Punycode and escaped control characters prevent display ambiguity.

Unreadable or incomplete requests require raw-data expansion and an unchecked risk acknowledgment. Reject is primary and initially focused; Sign anyway remains secondary. Invalid parsed data cannot be approved; flagged sites expose Close only.

Exact-byte EVM/Substrate messages and structured typed-data fields are readable; known Solana System transfer, SPL TransferChecked and Memo instructions have bounded summaries. Unknown instructions, unresolved lookup addresses and incomplete typed data require blind consent. Every current EVM transaction requires blind consent because empty calldata can still execute contract fallback/receive code.

Background phishing veto runs before signing-key or mobile access and rechecks request identity after the lookup; Substrate/Solana duplicate claims span that await. Store feedback distinguishes actual backend success from false return values.

Normalize JSON-RPC gas to ethers gasLimit without mutating input; conflicting limits fail before key export. Tighten Solana canonical short-u16, signature envelope and account/program-index checks while retaining compiled instructions for review.

Short viewports scroll the entire sheet so translated headers cannot trap the review below a fixed header; narrow decorative logos yield space to the title. Four shipped locale catalogs include the explicit warning and control states.

browser.transport: Public display-only signing fixtures; popup port intercepts approval before worker. Exactly one captured approval, no chain signing or broadcast. Local phishing-list response only; other fixture network traffic remains blocked.

Substrate/Solana immutable payload ownership, authorization revocation and late completion/broadcast boundaries remain to be finished. The phishing gate does not replace those checks. External signature completion also requires broader protocol/ownership review.
Typed-data backend schema/domain/primary-type and v1/v3/v4 semantic alignment remain open. A rendered structured preview is not proof that every legacy backend signs the displayed object identically.
